title: Crossing limit cycles of discontinuous piecewise differential systems with nilpotent saddles separated by a nonregular line
summary: In this paper, we study crossing limit cycles of planar discontinuous piecewise differential systems separated by a nonregular switching line, where one subsystem is a linear differential center and the other belongs to one of six families of Hamiltonian nilpotent saddle systems. This work extends previous results for discontinuous piecewise differential systems separated by a straight line to the more general setting of nonregular switching boundaries.
